row.evidence: Thought Industries' pricing page lists Single Sign-On (SSO) on Starter, Professional and Enterprise and API access on Enterprise only, and its developer hub and help centre document SAML, OIDC and JWT SSO plus a REST users API but no SCIM endpoint.
row.notes: No SCIM by absence (rule 5): pricing page, developer hub sitemap and llms.txt, REST API reference and help-centre search ('scim' and 'okta' return 0 articles) were checked. Quote-only pricing: all three tiers say Let's talk. SSO (SAML 2.0, OIDC, JWT) is ticked on every tier. Users arrive by SSO, CSV bulk import or the REST users API (Enterprise only per the pricing table; 'Workflows with Webhooks, SFTP, and API').

auth.notes: Bearer API key; key inherits the permissions of the role assigned at creation.

Make a user a manager-learner dual role
